questions.question: Name three stage types and explain how each affects the audience-performer relationship.

points.text: Three named types with clear explanation of audience positioning and the performer relationship — e.g. proscenium creates distance/thrust creates intimacy/in-the-round creates total immersion.

questions.question: A director wants to create an intimate, immersive experience. Which stage type would you recommend and why?

points.text: A justified recommendation (e.g. promenade or in-the-round) with specific reasons about audience proximity, sight lines and the immersive qualities the stage type enables.

questions.question: Compare the advantages and disadvantages of performing in-the-round versus a proscenium arch stage.

points.text: A balanced comparison: in-the-round gives intimacy and 360-degree audience engagement but requires constant movement management; proscenium allows controlled focus and set design but creates distance.
